notes.title: How Negotiation Breaks the Toxic Cycle of Domination/Submission
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/c2528410ba79d9eada2b247647c58647a5a8234b.png

Without language, without negotiation, most creatures are subject to a toxic relationship: dominate or be dominated.

Communicating ideas is hard, being understood is even harder. The human race, or more precisely the human brain, has worked over thousands of generations to build its language capacity, its ability to persuade without violence, its ability to... negotiate.

Without language, without communication, without negotiation, there is no cooperation.

[Negotiation is one of the elements that sets humans apart from animals. It is one of the evolutions that has lifted humanity out of barbarism/plunder to pave the way for diplomacy, trade, and exchange

We live in a time that gives us the illusion that it has always been easy to talk to each other. But if you have ever raised a 2-year-old child, or if you have been in a relationship, you know how untrue that is.

The beauty behind the scientific miracle of communication
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/a6ff18b3793775a7fd8e5274fbb48dddf7680dd3.png

When we zoom in on the human brain, in this bundle of neurons, we realize how miraculous communication is. A series of electrical and chemical signals form an idea, this idea is converted into sounds through movements of the tongue, air expelled from the lungs, and our larynx emitting a voice. Another human being receives these sounds through their eardrum, decoding the words, isolating them from ambient noise, and their neurons must produce electrical and chemical signals to visualize and understand the original idea. 
And as if that weren't complex enough, the recipient's brain evaluates its interest and survival based on the idea it received. It must also combine what it hears with body language, etc.

If we zoom in on the details, two beings negotiating are performing a very complex operation that represents the culmination of millions of years of known evolution. We experience this miracle every day without appreciating its exceptional nature (We have too many bills to pay that hide paradise from us 😅)
In creating Aurion, we wanted to reconnect humans to the extraordinary aspect and true power of negotiation. 

Let the symbolism in our universe awaken the sacred sense that everyday life causes us to lose.

Aurion is the energy that channels the ambitions of all living beings. Beyond physical combat, Aurion reacts to negotiations where each being tries to convince the other of their point of view.
In volume 9, we can see the king of Zama negotiating with the notable Bilandil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/fa695c93d9549f6906aa65be0545fb4d0201b5a7.png

Each of them gathers their Aurion to defend their point of view by "vibrating" the best of themselves. Writing this scene was difficult and exciting. We had to illustrate for the first time the vibratory aspect of our civilization, but also build the dialogue like a verbal joust that exploits the laws of military strategy. 

To negotiate, some humans will speak from their hearts to convince through intensity, they are like infantry knights. Enkwo is in this category, charging with his passion that almost shakes Bilandil for a moment. Others are like archers who send distant arguments without exposing themselves emotionally too much like Bilandil does at the beginning of the discussion.

The infantryman then protects himself with the shield of his convictions. And when an archer fails to hit a knight with his arrows, he quietly approaches to strike a dagger blow in the weak point of the armor.
It is through this analogy that Bilandil pushes Enkwo to lose his calm and the king of Zama distracts his honor Aurion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/75f4afaecb50c9504294508d6b62f7e8541a84a2.png

If Bilandil and Enkwo illustrate the verbal joust of negotiation, Ewineh's intervention was supposed to show something else. Ewineh observes the two Aurionics clash and end up at an impasse. And here we come to the most powerful aspect of negotiation: consensus.


Consensus involves allowing everyone to win what is most important to them by sacrificing some of their raw objectives. This frees us from the cycle of domination/submission to enter cooperation. Nothing in this scene is random. The consensus emerges from a sincere intention to make everyone win. It is the ability to understand the vibrations of both parties and find their common ground.
It is a symbol that we wanted to leave to the readers to inspire them for their real life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/c2528410ba79d9eada2b247647c58647a5a8234b.png

When you have to negotiate, try to be Ewineh in the room as much as possible if your basic arguments lead to a deadlock. It is a difficult path that requires stepping back. Ewineh was able to do this because she had perspective on the original conflict. The most beautiful evolutions of humanity have occurred when we have broken cycles of domination/submission through cooperation.

Negotiation is one of the key pillars for cooperation.

We hope that reading Aurion will inspire you to be a better human who cooperates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/068dc01b3c78cd7366711bbf2ef31d9c26fa43d7.jpg

Aurion is an epic story in games, graphic novels and anime about the challenge and struggle to stay a kind and altruistic human in a cynical and selfish world. How do you believe in the light without being naïve and abused by the darkness?

Discover extraordinary battles, and endearing heroes in the Kori-Odan saga with 3 free volumes on our animated website : https://join.aurionverse.com/

notes.title: The Good The Bad and The Ugly of religion depicted in our Game
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/e4d203c7589311b6003a5e483174e081f7559ff6.jpg
Religion (or spirituality) is one of the most beautiful things that connects us to the divine and the sacred, but alas, it's also often the source of abuse and control by ill-intentioned people.

So as humans, how can we be sure that we're staying on the right track in our quest for the divine and the sacred, in the face of all the spiritual swindling that's going on in this world?

As a gaming studio, we don't claim to have the ultimate answer to this lifelong quest and there are better theological experts from different backgrounds dedicated to it.

However, when we were building the Aurion universe we focused our lore on the human's existential quest. In a classic Fantasy universe, people obtain powers by training, by prophecy, or by gathering sacred powers/artifacts in sacred places. In the Aurion energy, power is directly connected to your capacity to answer the question “Who Am I”?

The more you know who you are, the more your convictions channel the existential particles in the universe and that’s how you assemble your Aurion.
With this in mind, it was inevitable to dive into the religious and spiritual questions in our world. We decided to show the dichotomy between the positive and negative sides of religion/spirituality.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/3a47a81e2a924820f385f314637cc0d226275ae0.jpg
 

The good side of religion/spirituality: Connecting us to the Truth and essence of things.

One example of the positive aspect of religion/spirituality can be seen during the Kori-Odan wedding scene, where the 4 notables are positioned like 4 pillars around our heroes.

Unlike a lot of real-life weddings where there is often only one priest representing a monotheist deity (and authority), in the city of Zama and many other tribes of Aurion Universe, humans believe (in fact they feel) that all cycles (nature, marriage, life) will need 4 winds to be sustainable. Four winds represent the four poles (north, East, South, West) or others aspects of Harmony.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/b601530f413ffffe7f9f0d25c897a2285a4d6c51.jpg

What we wanted to show there is that religion and spirituality may give the best when they are like a game of symbols organized to remind us of the “wisdom” of the Creation and why we should understand the balance of the sacred to mimic it in our life.

There are of course other aspects to this relationship with harmony and the surrounding cosmos, that you can find in Aurion. Every page and every screenshot has a symbol for something (funny or serious) that we invite readers, players to “decode”.

 

The bad and the Ugly of religion/spirituality: Giving control of your life to the wrong people.

Religion itself is not the problem, but some people will use it to abuse others. In Aurion, you can see an example when our heroes arrive in Isao's city and meet the false prophet who exploits the desperation of the citizens during an economic crisis.

This false prophet sees it as a business to make money, he explains that “hope” is a commodity that people want and that he offers. For him, people don’t want the truth if the truth is not “nice”, so he gives them what they ask (A B2C entrepreneur!).

Of course, our heroes will respond to that and fight him to stop the spiritual scam, but in real life, there are a lot of humans caught in vicious spiritual exploitation cycles.

I remember my grandmother speaking about couples who were broken when she was young because of the catholic versus protestant church competitions. It was a real thing 80 years ago. Some families were broken because of these inter church fights. Let’s not even talk about men enslaving women in a lot of places in the world because of religious justification.

The melody of possibilities

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/178c32304d14dd5c28ee4f281df017468b7d38ad.jpg

This is just a glimpse of our religious analysis in our universe that goes much further than that. We have built a whole cosmogony that goes back over 5,000 years.

In the PC game, there is a discussion of the griot ENIKI SOULEYRIS, who explains the origin of life in our universe, and how this is strangely linked to the heroes' quest, or the Aurion itself, which is ultimately a force that reacts only to the quest for who we are and to the relationship with the human soul. 
That is to say, in our universe, religion/spirituality is more oriented towards the soul reaching its full potential than towards divinities and human prophets. 

And somewhere along the line, as creators, we have the intuition and feeling that this focusing on the soul-sacred quest, is a path that, without being a guarantee or better than others, can perhaps inspire and help us stay connected to the sacred and divine within ourselves.

Aurion is an epic story about the challenge and struggle to stay a good and virtuous human in a cynical and selfish world. How do you believe in the light without being naïve and abused by the darkness?

Do not miss anything about our next epic adventures...

Come and experience the progress of the work in real time and also discuss with us on our Discord discussion forum with anime and video games fan like you.

Aurion is an awarded crossmedia Fantasy Universe with epic combats and one of the best story about changing the world.

notes.title: Competition is real and BRUTAL!
notes.content:
If you are born in the '80s-90s, your childhood was probably filled with symbols of "good" and the "power of love and friendship" (Thanks Disney).

But when you started to move to adulthood, you have probably been shocked by the "reality" of the world: The violence, the selfishness, the law of the "strongest", the sad death of a kind and naïve people when they faced bad people around you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/6a3e11085249330e86f61aadd3589d4708dad39a.png


But when you started to move to adulthood, you have probably been shocked by the "reality" of the world: The violence, the selfishness, the law of the "strongest", the sad death of kind and naïve people when they faced bad people around you.

A lot of us picked a team on the road:
- "Team cynical": Often calling them "Team pragmatic" depending on the level of cynism the have. The more extrem cynicals peoples believe that "Well if the world is a pure hell, let's be the King of Evil. It's me against all of you"
- "Team Idealist": Often calling them "Team positivity" depending on the level of savior complex. Their conclusion was "Everything will end well if we keep doing good around us, every one can become good". And they often end up with a lot of desillusions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/4c94e8c7d176cb2cb642afa96ec0959a8abe6f47.png

And there is a lot of subteams that I can't list here: team I don't care, team I care too much, team ect. And I am even sure that we are all members of at least 3 to 5 teams depending on the day.

Since I was a kid, I was asking if there was not a "Team Truth".
I was always asking what is the Truth in all those paths. Which of those extreme paths is really leading to better results for most of us?

I realized that all those paths are in fact part of the only path.
That our race, the human race may have been created only for the purpose of testing and combining all those approaches of Life until we find the Harmony.

And that's where cooperation is the only key.
Being pragmatic is a good thing at the right timing.
Being Positive and indealist is also a good thing at the right timing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/bfa5ab1bf3837114cbfe7f2b8a8964a6bf530af0.jpg

No one can "feel" the right timing alone.
We always need someone else on the other side of the labyrinth that we can trust.

We are not competing to find the better path, we have to cooperate to get out of the same labyrinth.

This dilemma is one of the core sources of inspiration in our Fantasy World Aurion. In the Aurion, there are no good vs Evils, no prophecy, no Chosen Ones. Only an existential war between all the human spiritual diversity trying to find... the "Truth".

If you like Fantasy story with epic and intense battles, but also stories that will make you have fun and grow at the same time, Come and "Decode" the AurionVerse with us in games, graphic novels. Join our community and get 3 volumes for free: http://join.aurionverse.com/

notes.title: When realism puts our idealism to a very severe test!
notes.content:
As gamers, we tend to embody beings who start out as weak, and who over combats, face enemies and lead battles that from the start seemed impossible to win. This creates a great sense of idealism in us. 

But!!! Once we get out of there, we face the harshness of life and ‘‘realism’’ that the world throws in our faces, which creates in us a kind of dissonance that we constantly seek to balance. No longer knowing where begins Realism and where idealism and honor end.

The game therefore depicts a conflict between honor and realism, two values which are embodied by two main characters of the game : Enzo (Enkwo) and his ju'u (master) Nama Yode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/c3b464f8ace4d7e7c3f07643fa607a49b829ce9d.jpg


• Enzo (Enkwo) is an idealistic and optimistic hero, who believes in justice, freedom and fraternity between people. He is guided by his honor, which requires him to respect his commitments, to protect the innocent and to fight evil.

But his idealism borders on utopia and even naivety. Knowing nothing other than his peaceful and sweet city of Zama, he is brutally confronted with the reality of the "outside world" and will face its harshness and the titanic challenges that his rank as King of Zama implies. And his master Nama yode will make it clear to him.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/58a00bd5a8bc7829e6818896183890351ac2db02.jpg

• Nama Yode, on the contrary, is an Aurionic master who has renounced her candor to access a higher level of power. She embodies realism which is one of the primary socles in the Yode clan, that is to say objective and rational knowledge of the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/4a8954b9fdb610f3b4772cd41b3a04293da36470.jpg

For her it is necessary to take things for what they are and not for what we think they are (difficult to do, right !?).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/bfa5ab1bf3837114cbfe7f2b8a8964a6bf530af0.jpg

She considers that honor is a luxury that only those who have the means to keep it can afford. So one must be strong, very strong in the face of adversity to claim it. Through her power she wants to impose her ideal on the whole world, and she believes that there is no right way to get there, there is only the way that wins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/21037edb41fb2c583c49578b766e0e3b54b3e690.jpg

The game thus offers a reflection on the meaning of life, on the choice between the ideal and the real, between faith and skepticism. The player is led to question his own values, what constitutes his dignity and his greatness of soul.
 The game also shows that honor and realism are not necessarily incompatible, but that they can complement and reinforce each other.

  Enzo (Enkwo) learns throughout his adventure to be realistic, to recognize his limits and his errors, to accept the complexity of the world and its geopolitical issues. Nama Yode, for her part, teaches her student that his honor is sure a beautiful thing, but it must be sublimated with a layer of realism, this to cultivate pragmatism, in order to be able to face evil without ever losing the light that shines in his soul.

notes.title: When heroes depression teaches us how to handle our fear.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/eeb5dd0eccd3043b4e24d1d3045634a3061e0536.jpg

We are all inspired by heroes with infinite courage and infinite strenght. Those who never give up and who never fail. But we are more inspired by those who fall and who get up again.

No one achieves perfect wins all the time, we will fail and cry. We will feel that we are not worthy for our dreams, not enough skilled for our duties.

There are two critical moments in life when the "fear to fail" will hit you harder and bring you close to depression:

 When you start your journey and you see all the challenges coming.
  When you are close to succeed on your main goal and you realize that  it was not the "endgame" but the start of another level of apocalypse.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/2d0cfd36349ec9815d05cd2333fd919ef6a0280d.jpg

That's normal to fear, this is "the growth path ".
We are all normal humans seaking for greatness despite our imperfections. And we should never be ashamed of that. We need symbols on our way showing us the light again and again.

That's why we wrote the "prince depression" passage in Aurion. At some point in the story, Enkwo is totally overwhelmed by the challenges of the world out of Zama.

After his greatest victory, Enkwo finally realize that he is powerful enough to take back his kingdom. But the freedom of Zama is not the "endgame", it's just a checkpoint of a greatest and more difficult challenge.

Like a lot of us Enkwo had first to go through a denial moment (in good company with the funny Dramane)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/f9055cf9502c133c6b417b057224f8fad182e26e.jpg

Then when he hits the bottom, he decide  to face the truth again, with a more calm and pragmatic mindset.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/2c5ca713e7d78a4a9b84b8cb631f684f47d3d76c.jpg

When fear is paralyzing you, one of the most important solution  is to be honest with yourself. Don't deny your emotion, face them with calm and resilience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/b96202f02b77b55889406ff5333bc1a13055125a.jpg

The ultimate power to overcome fear, may lie in the love we have for someone else  (our kids, friends, lovers, parents, cats, dogs, etc). And the fact we are willing to strive to protect this other one.

If you enjoy meditating on your life, and you also love epic Fantasy stories. Play Aurion here on Steam and get 3 volumes of the Aurion Graphic Novel by clicking on the picture below.

notes.title: The AurionVerse is coming soon... With a new Trailer
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9303013/a048354c8ef219766d2046c0cf688400de245e4e.jpg

Dear Aurionics, 
After a long time of silence and preparation: the AurionVerse is about to make a decisive evolution.
Since the release of Aurion LKO, we have worked in backstage to extend our universe, to clarify our vision.

We are sorry for the silence.
We are sorry if you felt abandonned.

You may not believe it, but we are still learning ourselves about the unique universe we are creating.
As you can see we changed the game description to be more suitable.
We just realised because of all your feedbacks that Aurion is a story driven game, not a beat them all and not an Action Game.

What happened since?

We struggled a lot to define our vision and culture for Kiroo and Aurion.
We struggled even more to rebuild and retrain a full team.
We ended the partnership (in good terms) with our publisher. So we are full indie and have more control on the community.
We Extented Aurion a a CrossMedia (Graphic Novel, Mobile Game)



So Where are we going from here?

notes.title: Comic News: a visual boost for Aurion Volume 2
notes.content:
Volume 2 and part 6 of the Aurion fantasy comic are finally available. The initiatory journey of the Kori-Odan carries on here, with more than 250 colored pages full of epic adventures, "badass" battles and existential dilemmas with a rare intensity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/bb128bbc0857088de56871cc3f87be2fb3c3b175.jpg

This December 03, 2020, Kiro'o Games reveals the much-awaited volume 2 collector's edition of the colorful fantasy comic Aurion: The Legacy of the Kori-Odan. The release of part 6 of this fantasy comic completes volume 2, which now includes three parts (parts 4, 5 and 6). One year after the release of the first volume Aurion, Kiro'o is back with the rest of his comic, something to satisfy his entire community.

While in volume 1 the readers discovered the beginning of the saga of the Kori-Odan couple, punctuated by strong rivalries and the crisis of a military coup, in volume 2 the story highlights the candor and courage of our heroes facing the sometimes-cruel realities of life outside the cocoon of the city of Zama.

Here, the authors offer a  real visual and narrative step up in the quality of their masterpiece :


 An even more dynamic staging of the combat scenes to allow readers to easily animate each confrontation ;


 A progression in the volume of dialogues with more reflections on human paradoxes; 


 Scenes of Afro-Fantasy sets magnified to offer to the readers more moments of contemplation ; 


 A real dive in the Nubian mythology to densify this fantasy universe of Aurion.


[previewyoutube=AHjt_UpYHcA;full][/previewyoutube]

Aurion, a new genre of fantasy comic? 

If the story of Aurion draws its inspiration from African mythology, the fact remains that in this comic strip, Kiro'o got their inspiration from Shônen manga and comics to build his genre.

Indeed, Aurion feeds on both the manga style and the comic style, and enhances itself with a certain creative freedom, coming from both the authors and the community : 


 The staging of the combat scenes, the dynamism of the movements, and even more, the exploitation of some manga tropes (disproportion of the actions, names of the technics, chibi gags etc.) all pay tribute to the manga.


 On the other hand, in Aurion, we also find quite a number of western comic book tropes, such as color illustrations, the asymmetries of the boxes, the typical features of comic characters, or a narrative well centered on socio-cultural themes (tribalism, military coup).


"Aurion is a love letter to both manga and comic book creators out there with a touch of African ideologies." Says Willy Essombe, an artist at the studio.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/6f105396a4cf44684f2c76e5ad0b4bdb3ed7c415.jpg

From PC Game to Manga: Aurion joins the club of Trans-Media Made in Africa licenses!

Video game critics are unanimous: Aurion, the first Afro-Fantasy Action-RPG, is a masterpiece for the quality of the scenario and the story. By developing Aurion in a fantasy comic format, the goal of Kiro’o Games was clearly to:


 Showcase this world of Afro-Fantasy to a larger community;


 Prove to viewers and potential partners that a product made in Africa can have a future as strong as those of the big houses of global entertainment can.


“Kiro'o Games has always had the medium and long term objective of becoming a capital pole of African Entertainment. Therefore, it seemed important to us to make Aurion, a cross-platform project as the universe has a huge potential,” says Yakan Dominique Lead Creative Designer of Kiro'o Games.

No African creation has ever succeeded in this challenge: to move from video games to a fantasy comic adaptation. Aurion would therefore be a strong license with a real Trans-media potential. With such a large universe, there would be enough to do even more: animated films, animated series, or even mobile games...

Moreover, an adaptation of Aurion as a mobile game is announced for the year 2021, details of this project will soon be revealed to the public.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9303013/11bfb04d8e3a5abb212a9246abf5312c6dfb96d1.jpg

Colored board, comic-style strokes, staging closer to Shônen for a writing oriented Seïnen African Fantasy. Aurion is definitely not a traditional Fantasy comic.

Aurion a writing that announces his anime?

An adaption into an anime is often the result of a captivating story immersed in a new and large universe. Aurion meets these conditions because if one explores only the Kori-Odan saga, the fantasy comic could be written over at least 200 chapters. 

Kiro'o has already started to pre-write the other bows of the Aurionic history, which is what leads us to think that an Aurion anime could be born. The authors of Aurion are already building and cutting out the current fantasy comic as a giant storyboard of what the anime could represent. 

While waiting for a potential anime version of Aurion, discover in exclusivity on Amazon:


 Volume 2 is a collector's edition of the Aurion fantasy comic including Parts 4, 5 and 6 ;


 Part 6 of the Aurion fantasy comic for those who have already read parts 4 and 5


 Part 5 of Aurion in comics  with chapters 12, 13 and 14 and 100 colored pages.


Also, discover


 The free version of Aurion fantasy comic here for fantasy comic scan readers ;


 The A-RPG Aurion for Pc Gamers.

notes.title: Aurionic Patch 1.00 (17-04-2016)
notes.content:
Hello dear Aurionics, 
Thanks to your feedbacks these first days, we managed to make some fixes on the game. 
The "anti translation gate" is still on progress and we hope a big patch about this matter next week. 
But it seems after those 1st hours the game is better translated on its current state. That's the feedback of some players at least. 

http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/kiroo_astral_v100.jpg

Anyway, we keep forwarding your passion and the pressure to our partner. 

 Resetting the matching window keyboard Pad 
 Modify Sidune’s AI so he can now launch his Ultimate Legacy 
 Modify the Enzo face during Aurionic fusion. 
 Players can now use F5 to quit fullscreen Mode 
 Title Menu : debug of the glitches with the party menu. 
 “Achievement” menu has been renamed as “Steam”, since it will also contain the DLC list. 
 Adding the “return” word in the loading save windows 
 Fix the success “Launch 30 Ultimate Legacy”. 
 Debug of the camera glitch which often suddenly get back on Enzo. 
 Insertion of some text full translated (Items, Aurionites, and the 
beginning of Zama, just before you talk with the old griot) 
 Light remapping of the Elorine combat zone. 
 Updated the pictures on the Aurionic fusion tutorial. 

We hope to see you continue playing and we are curious to get your feedbacks, especially the feedback of the 1st one who will finish the game. The end is... well you will see. But as old RPG gamers, we think we have created something there. 

Update 10 a.m : We fixed the Koross boss fight and the Nabi Dialog fault due to some missing fonts in the English version of the game. For the final mistakes about the text (text out of some bubbles, etc.) we are waiting for the final English patch to correct it.


Update 8 p.m : we fixed the micro stuttering from the morning patch (if you continue to have ones, just turn off post processing in option it helps). Also we fixed a shop bug with the keyboard. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: AURION: legacy of kori-odan challenges the fighting spirit of gamers.
notes.content:
http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/img0.jpg
Aurion: The Legacy of Kori-Odan will be available on Steam from the 14th of April 2016. We will appreciate to count you among our growing players’ community. In order to give you another fore-taste (besides the trailer on Awakening that was released in February 2016), we go further by proposing to you the challenge of apprehending the martial art of Enzo Kori-Odan, this will call upon your fighting spirit and your individual style as a gamer, through the path of  "Caaro Aargudan"

Following the occasion of its release, the Action-RPG Aurion: The Legacy of Kori-Odan proposes a specific challenge to all the gamers, through a series of gameplay videos named  "combat system : Caaro Aargudan" meaning "Vengeful Spider ".

http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/img1.jpg
Thus, this first issue of a series of videos based on this martial art in a Kiro’o games spirit is available for gamers and fans of combos and skills. These videos invite you to understand the strategies and creativity necessary to exploit to a maximum your gameplay. Indeed, the gameplay of Aurion has been conceived based on a Gamification approach defined at 2 levels:

The Martial art of Enzo as a character : The player has at his disposal a palette of skills and an open gameplay, this offers the possibility to perform an infinite varieties of combos
The Martial art from the player’s viewpoint : Kiro’o invites the players to put themselves in a warrior’s state of mind in order to push this system to its retrenchment. Each player must develop his perfect web in order to express his creativity as a warrior

https://youtu.be/ZcmH7RvnjIA
As you’ve seen in the above video, the conceived battle system enables you with each move, to perform any following one as it suits you. Thus, « Button smashing » or repetition of the same moves is forbidden even if possible. Each player is invited to develop his own unique style.
But KIRO’O GAMES reassures you : 
We shouldn’t forget that we’re in an Action-RPG. Beyond the fighting styles, victory depends on the management of stamina and Action Points (AP). Furthermore, bosses and various enemies AIs donnot follow a predefined pattern but instead re-act to your moves in real time

WHAT’S CAARO AARGUDAN ?
Caaro Argudan is a feline martial art used by the main character Enzo Kori-Odan. He has been trained to master it by his Ju’u or mentor Nama Yodé. Erine Kori-Odan being a back-up for Enzo during battles, she often uses some skills of this martial art. This martial art is based on the ability to counterattack and specific predispositions to agility.
A series of various videos based on this martial art are on the way and will be posted in the developper’s official Youtube channel as well as in the Steam community.

Looking forward to the 14th and don’t hesitate to be part of the Legacy ! !

notes.title: AURION : L'héritage des Kori-odan veut défier la combativité des joueurs
notes.content:
http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/img0.jpg
 Aurion l'Héritage des Kori-Odan sera disponible à partir du 14 avril 2016 sur Steam. Nous saurons vous compter nombreux parmi les joueurs. Afin de vous donner un autre avant-goût (outre le récent trailer de l'Eveil de Février 2016), nous vous proposons le défi de pouvoir appréhender l'art du combat selon ENZO Kori-Odan, qui fera appel à votre esprit combatif et votre technique individuelle en tant que gamer, à travers la voie du "Caaro Aargudan".

A l'occasion de sa sortie, l’Action-RPG Aurion l'Héritage des Kori-Odan propose un défi aux joueurs, à travers une série de vidéos gameplay baptisée "Système de combat : Caaro Aargudan" qui signifie « Araignée Vengeuse".

http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/img1.jpg
En effet, la première d'une série de vidéo sur l'art du combat à la sauce Kiro'o Games est disponible pour les gamers fans de combo et de skills. Elle vous initie à comprendre la stratégie et la créativité combative nécessaire pour exploiter le gameplay au maximum. En effet, le gameplay de combat d’Aurion a été créé selon une approche de gamification, qui se situe sur deux niveaux :

L'art de combat d'Enzo en tant que personnage : le joueur disposera d'une palette de techniques et d'un gameplay ouvert, lui permettant de réaliser des combos variés à volonté 
L'art de combat du point de vue du joueur : Kiro’o veut voir les joueur se mettre dans un état d’esprit de guerrier pour pousser leur système dans ses retranchements. Chaque joueur doit chercher « la toile parfaite » pour exprimer sa créativité combattante.

 Lien vers la vidéo

Comme visionné sur la vidéo ci-dessus, le système de combat créé vous permet à chaque mouvement, de passer à celui qui vous inspire sur le moment. Ici donc, pas de « Button Mashing » ou de répétition des mêmes mouvements même s'ils sont possibles, mais un challenge pour chaque gamer à exprimer son style. 

Mais KIRO’O Games rassure : 
Il faut rappeler que nous sommes dans un Action-RPG. Au-delà du style, la victoire repose sur la gestion des gauges d’endurance et de magie. De plus les boss et ennemis ne réagissent pas selon des patterns prédéfinis, ils sont dotés d’une  IA faites pour réagir au joueur en temps réel. 

QU'EST-CE QUE LE CAARO AARGUDAN ?
Le Caaro Aargudan est un style combatif félin, un art martial qu'utilise Enzo Kori-Odan. Il lui a été enseigné par son "Ju'u" ou Maître de combat Nama Yodé. Erine Kori-Odan étant un soutien pour Enzo durant les combats, elle utilise également certains aspects de cette technique. Le style est basé sur la puissance de contre et demande des prédispositions d'agilité particulières.
Plusieurs vidéo de cet art de jouer sont à venir et seront publiés sur la chaîne des développeurs ou dans leur communauté Steam.

Vivement le 14 avril et n'hésitez pas à devenir une partie de l’Héritage !
